paragraphs: Hi! I'm Youssef Abaali, a Motion Graphics Designer working as a Freelancer and based in Spain. Since 2017, I've been diving into the world of motion design, gaining extensive experience in executing motion graphics projects from start to finish.
My goal is to transform complex ideas into smooth and impactful visual stories.

I'm perfectly comfortable managing the entire creative process, as I'm skilled at jumping into every stage of production from sketching the initial concepts and building the storyboard, through to the illustration phase, and finally the animation itself.
Currently, I work independently, collaborating with various clients and studios.

I focus on helping clients simplify their messages and achieve their marketing goals through motion, while maintaining a commitment to high-quality and effective design across all aspects of motion graphics.

projectDetails.title: 247 MAINTENANCE - HOME SERVICES PLATFORM
projectDetails.shortDescription:
I partnered with 247 Maintenance to create an explainer video showing how their platform connects UAE homeowners with trusted technicians. 

The goal was to explain their services clearly while presenting the brand in a modern, engaging way.
projectDetails.description:
To give the video a polished feel, I combined 3D elements with a flat 2D world. 

This contrast added visual depth, helping key elements pop on screen and hold the viewer's attention throughout the video.

projectDetails.title: SHOWREEL 2025
projectDetails.shortDescription:
To showcase my growth and visual style, I needed a central video that brings together my best work. 

I curated this showreel to highlight my design identity, quality, and motion skills across different projects.
projectDetails.description:
The biggest challenge was choosing only the most impactful clips from a large archive of work. 

I focused on creating a smooth visual rhythm, carefully syncing every movement and transition to the music to guide the viewer’s eye seamlessly through the reel.

projectDetails.title: COMÈTE STUDIO - CONCEPTUAL MOTION GRAPHICS
projectDetails.shortDescription:
Montreal-based Comète Studio needed a conceptual narrative video to highlight their ability to turn dry, complex social issues into captivating visual artwork. 
I collaborated with the studio to translate their static illustrations into a dynamic visual story that conveys deep narrative meaning with high artistic polish.
projectDetails.description:
To capture the psychological weight of the narrative, the core execution focused on translating static visual concepts into deliberate, meaningful movement. 
I crafted fluid, seamless transitions between scenes, giving physical rhythm to the artwork so that every motion directly reinforces the emotional progression of the story.

projectDetails.title: WORKLEAP - SPHERICAL PROJECTION MAPPING
projectDetails.shortDescription:
To bring their remote-first team together and unveil their 2026 strategic vision, Workleap needed an immersive visual centerpiece for their annual gathering. 

I translated the company's static brand designs into dynamic motion graphics specifically tailored for a physical spherical projection display.

sections.textContent:
Animating graphics for a large physical sphere comes with a unique challenge: flat designs can easily stretch or warp when projected onto a round surface. 

Working within a 3780×1080 pixel canvas, I carefully adjusted the scale, positioning, and movement speed of the visual elements. 

This ensured that every animation wrapped naturally around the curved display, delivering a clear and distortion-free experience for everyone in the room.

projectDetails.title: AINSI VA MANU - ON SCREEN MOTION GRAPHICS
projectDetails.shortDescription:
For the drama series Ainsi va Manu which follows a 16-year-old fighting against eviction 
the director needed custom screen graphics to help tell the story. 

I designed and animated digital graphics that appear on characters phones and computer screens to support the narrative and reflect the show's dramatic energy.
projectDetails.description:
I created simple, realistic screen interfaces for the phones and laptops featured throughout the show. 

By making the screens clear to read and matching the timing of the animations to the actors movements and the scene's mood, the graphics felt completely natural and helped build the drama without distracting the audience.

projectDetails.title: POKA - INTRODUCING POKA ASSISTANT
projectDetails.shortDescription:
Poka is a Canadian software platform trusted by major manufacturers like Nestlé and L'Oréal. 

To introduce Poka Assistant an AI tool that turns long factory manuals into simple, step-by-step guides 

I animated the internal team's static designs to help explain this new technology clearly.
projectDetails.description:
The main challenge was making smart software concepts easy to understand for everyone. 
I animated the visual elements to show the AI in action clearly showing how long documents break down into short steps using smooth movements to keep the video clear, engaging, and professional.

projectDetails.title: CLUB DE LECTURE - WHERE BOOKS MEET MUSIC
projectDetails.shortDescription:
To launch "Club de Lecture" a music video series filmed inside their Montreal store, Librairie l'Échange needed a short animated logo to start each episode. 

I animated their logo into a sleek, 2-second intro designed to make a strong first impression in a very short time.
projectDetails.description:
Creating a fast 2-second animation meant every single frame mattered. Before animating, I built a step-by-step storyboard to plan out the exact movement and timing. 

Sharing this plan early ensured we were fully aligned on the motion, making the final animation feel smooth and clear rather than rushed.

projectDetails.title: FO.NE.TIK - BRAND IDENTITY ANIMATION
projectDetails.shortDescription:
To launch their new brand identity, Montreal-based creative studio fo.ne.tik needed a video to introduce their core services. 

The studio provided the pre-designed scenes, and I animated them to create a clean, engaging video presentation that reflects their brand values.
projectDetails.description:
The focus was on giving smooth movement to simple elements like floating dots and text representing words. 

By using natural timing and gentle transitions between the provided scenes, the animation brings the studio's brand story to life in a way that is clear and easy to follow.

projectDetails.title: FO.NE.TIK - SHOWREEL ANIMATION
projectDetails.shortDescription:
Montreal-based creative studio fo.ne.tik needed a high-energy showreel to highlight their work across audiovisual production, brand creation, and cultural localization. 

Working directly from the video footage and storyboard provided by the client, I brought the project to life by animating their logo, text elements, and visual transitions.
projectDetails.description:
The main focus was delivering a dynamic, fast-paced style while keeping every scene clear and easy to follow. 

I crafted smooth transitions and tuned the timing of each text and logo animation to flow naturally with the video edits, ensuring the reel remains engaging and polished from start to finish.

projectDetails.title: WORKLEAP - BRAND IDENTITY SIZZLE REEL 1
projectDetails.shortDescription:
To help Workleap launch its new logo and updated website, I animated a short, energetic showcase video. 

I took their new visual design and brought it to life, creating a fast-paced video that clearly introduces their updated look to their audience.
projectDetails.description:
To keep the video engaging, I timed every visual movement directly to the beat of the music. 

I animated the logo using smooth slides and clean transitions, making sure the information was easy to read while maintaining a fast, upbeat pace throughout the video.

projectDetails.title: WORKLEAP - ISOMETRIC MOTION GRAPHICS
projectDetails.shortDescription:
Workleap is a software platform that offers AI-powered tools for employee performance management and training. 

To help present their platform, I animated a series of static isometric scenes provided by the client, turning them into a dynamic, engaging video.
projectDetails.description:
With a strict three-day deadline, animating in an isometric style was a major challenge, as it requires far more structural precision and alignment than a standard flat style. 

To hit this tight turnaround without compromising quality, I rebuilt the scenes and characters directly inside After Effects. 

This streamlined the workflow, making the animation process much faster while ensuring every movement remained smooth, precise, and consistent.

projectDetails.title: NYC EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT - TEXT BUBBLE DESIGN & ANIMATION
projectDetails.shortDescription:
NYC Emergency Management handles disaster response and public safety across New York City. 

To help them share clear safety messages and emergency alerts in their videos, I designed and animated custom text bubbles to highlight key information.
projectDetails.description:
Since these videos were targeted for small mobile screens, we went through several design revisions. 

I simplified the text bubbles by removing unnecessary elements and increasing the font size, making every alert bold, clear, and easy to read on phones.

projectDetails.title: EJADWA - FINANCIAL FEASIBILITY EXPLAINER VIDEO
projectDetails.shortDescription:
To help Ejadwa introduce its online platform for financial feasibility studies, I created a motion graphics explainer video. 

Starting with only a voiceover, I turned complex financial concepts into a simple visual story that is easy for anyone to understand.
projectDetails.description: Starting from initial sketches, I created the illustrations, animated each scene to match the voiceover, and added sound effects to complete the final video.

projectDetails.title: WORKLEAP - LOTTIE WEB ANIMATIONS
projectDetails.shortDescription:
Workleap is a software platform that offers AI-powered tools for employee performance management and training. 

To help make their website more engaging, I animated a set of client-provided illustrations into smooth, looping visuals that bring key features to life.
projectDetails.description:
To ensure the best visual experience on the web, I created and exported the animations directly as lightweight Lottie files in JSON format. 

Building them specifically for Lottie ensured that every loop plays smoothly and scales cleanly on any screen size, keeping the website fast and responsive.

projectDetails.title: WORKLEAP - LOTTIE WEB ANIMATIONS 2
projectDetails.shortDescription:
Workleap is a software platform that provides AI-powered tools for employee performance management and training. 

To make their website more engaging, I animated a set of client-provided UI illustrations into smooth, continuous loops that visually demonstrate the platform in action.
projectDetails.description:
To ensure a fast and responsive web experience, I animated and exported the illustrations directly as lightweight Lottie files in JSON format. 

Building them specifically as Lottie animations allowed the visual elements to play seamlessly and scale crisp and clear on any screen size without slowing down page load times.

projectDetails.title: SUCCESS FINDER — MINIMALIST MOTION DESIGN
projectDetails.shortDescription:
SuccessFinder is a Canadian platform specializing in behavioral analytics and HR solutions to help companies hire and develop talent. 

To help showcase their platform, I animated a set of illustrations provided by the client, which featured flat geometric shapes and character silhouettes.
projectDetails.description:
I focused on turning simple character silhouettes into smooth, beautifully animated figures. 

By adding clean and aesthetic movement to these basic shapes, I made the visuals engaging while keeping the video clear and easy to follow.

projectDetails.title: WEACTIS — CYBERSECURITY & SAFE COLLABORATION
projectDetails.shortDescription:
WeActis is a solution designed to reduce cybersecurity risks in Microsoft 365 by promoting safe employee collaboration. 

To present their platform, the client requested a simple, easy-to-read video that matched the visual style of their previous work. 

I started by designing scenes that aligned with their existing brand direction to set a consistent visual foundation.
projectDetails.description:
To keep complex cybersecurity topics easy to understand, the animation focused on clarity and simple visual flow. 

I brought the designed scenes to life using clean movements and smooth transitions, ensuring the final video remained clear, engaging, and easy for any viewer to follow without visual distractions.

projectDetails.title: WORKLEAP - BRAND SIZZLE REEL 2
projectDetails.shortDescription:
Following the success of Workleap’s first sizzle reel, I was brought back to animate a second video. 

Building on our previous collaboration, I took their updated visual style and created another energetic showcase video to keep their audience engaged.
projectDetails.description:
The main focus was matching every visual movement directly to the upbeat rhythm of the music. 

I carefully timed the transitions and motion graphics to the beat, making the motion feel natural while elevating the overall energy of the video.

projectDetails.title: WORKLEAP - BRAND SIZZLE REEL 3
projectDetails.shortDescription:
Continuing the successful video series for Workleap, I animated a third sizzle reel. 

Building on the style of the previous videos, I brought new visual elements to life to create another fast-paced showcase for their brand.
projectDetails.description:
To keep the same high energy as the previous reels, I synced every visual movement directly to the music track. 

I focused on clean transitions and smooth motion to keep the video engaging, clear, and easy to watch.

projectDetails.title: TABSEER - PRODUCT QUALITY EXPLAINER VIDEO
projectDetails.shortDescription:
Tabseer helps companies make sure their products meet safety and quality standards in the Middle East. 

To help them clearly explain their services to businesses, I created a full motion graphics explainer video.
projectDetails.description:
I handled the project from start to finish. 

I began with sketches and storyboards to plan out each scene, then animated the visuals, added custom sound effects, and completed the final video export.

projectDetails.title: MONDATA - CYBERSECURITY EXPLAINER VIDEO
projectDetails.shortDescription:
Mondata is a Canadian technology company that uses AI solutions to protect IT infrastructure against cyberattacks. 

To help them showcase their tailored cybersecurity services clearly and engagingly, I created a 60-second motion graphics explainer video in two language versions (English and French).
projectDetails.description:
Because the client provided a defined visual style and clear direction from the start, the production process was smooth and efficient. 

Once the visual designs were set, I animated the scenes with fluid movements to ensure the message was simple for viewers to follow, resulting in a final video that was approved right away with no revisions needed.
